responsibility: Declares the communication layer between jump-thread discovery and CFG/SSA updates. It defines jump_thread_edge and jump_thread_edge_type, allocators and abstract path registries, the forward and backward registry subclasses that apply threads, removed-edge bookkeeping, and helper interfaces for threading profitability and loop-domination checks used when validating registered threading paths.
same_name_distinction: This header is the coordination interface between thread discovery and thread application, defining jump_thread_edge, edge kinds, path allocators, registry classes, removed-edge tracking, and validation helpers. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-threadupdate.cc, it does not execute CFG duplication, rewiring, or SSA repairs.
